summary.zh-CN: 素材盘点、带时间码转写、粗剪方案与剪辑单、字幕校对、交付检查清单；没有媒体处理环境时交付的是方案与字幕文件，不是成片。
summary.en: Footage inventory, timecoded transcripts, rough-cut plans and edit lists, subtitle proofreading and delivery checklists; without a media environment the output is plans and subtitle files, not rendered video.

now.zh-CN: 登记素材清单与技术规格，未知项标「待确认」
now.en: Index footage and specs, marking unknowns for confirmation

now.zh-CN: 整理带时间码的文字稿，标注品牌词与低置信段
now.en: Clean timecoded transcripts and flag brand terms and low-confidence parts

now.zh-CN: 起草粗剪结构与剪辑单（入点、出点、画面、声音、字幕、转场）
now.en: Draft rough-cut structure and edit lists with in/out points, picture, sound, captions and transitions

now.zh-CN: 校对 SRT/VTT 字幕并按规格生成交付检查表
now.en: Proofread SRT/VTT subtitles and build delivery checklists per spec

needs.zh-CN: 素材清单或媒体信息、转写文本、字幕文件
needs.en: Footage lists or media info, transcripts and subtitle files
Brand term list and delivery specs

permissions.zh-CN: 不删除、不移动、不覆盖任何原始素材
permissions.en: Never deletes, moves or overwrites original footage

permissions.zh-CN: 需你确认才会做：渲染导出、上传或发布视频
permissions.en: Only with your confirmation: rendering, uploading or publishing video

conditions.zh-CN: 不含视频渲染；需要成片时另配媒体处理环境。
conditions.en: No rendering included; add a media processing environment when you need final video.
